control: Enterprise step-up MFA / IdP validation for critical actions
summary: EuroComply step-up tokens remain signed_hmac tokens, but issuance now requires a real Supabase MFA aal2 verification or a fresh enterprise IdP claim. Tokens are scoped by userId, organizationId and action, contain a single-use nonce, expire within five minutes and are consumed through a server-side Supabase token store. Team invite, member removal, role change and invitation cancellation management now enforce the same step-up helper after RBAC and before writes. Enterprise release remains blocked when a signing key and real MFA or IdP policy are not configured.
redactionConfirmation: All secrets, tokens, credentials, connection strings, and access-granting values are redacted.
controlsVerified: Token issuance requires Supabase MFA aal2 or configured enterprise IdP ACR/AMR claims.
Tokens are scoped by userId, organizationId and high-risk action.
Tokens include server-generated nonce, issuedAt, expiresAt and verificationMethod fields.
Tokens expire within five minutes and are consumed once from the server-side token store.
Critical routes reject missing, expired, replayed, cross-organization and cross-action tokens.
Team invite, team member removal, team role change and invitation cancellation require manage_team step-up after RBAC and before writes.
Team role changes block self-change, non-owner owner grants/removals and last-owner demotion.
Team UI uses the shared StepUpMfaDialog and sends x-eurocomply-step-up-token only to fixed protected API endpoints.
Enterprise release gate fails closed when signing configuration or real provider configuration is missing.

runtimeChecks: supabase.auth.mfa.verify or challengeAndVerify validates the submitted code
supabase.auth.mfa.getAuthenticatorAssuranceLevel must return aal2 before token issuance
auth_time or iat must be fresh within STEP_UP_MAX_AGE_MS
acr must match STEP_UP_IDP_ACR_VALUES or amr must match STEP_UP_IDP_AMR_VALUES
enterprise_idp.tokenIssuedOnlyAfter: fresh strong IdP reauthentication claim is present

change_security_settings: Security settings mutation routes must use requireStepUpForRequest before release when enabled

requires: Supabase MFA configuration or enterprise IdP ACR/AMR policy

limitations: This repository evidence validates implementation wiring and fail-closed behavior. Live provider execution must be run in an environment with real Supabase MFA or enterprise IdP credentials configured.
Security-settings mutation endpoints are not present as enabled write routes in this repository snapshot; any future route for those actions must be wired into requireStepUpForRequest before release.
